rule: S_N must not be null (mandatory primary/join key)
rationale: S_N is the unique table identifier and one-to-one join key with Acc_Info_dirty. No missing values currently observed, but enforcement required for data integrity.

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a primary identifier with 30 distinct values for 30 records. Must remain unique to maintain one-to-one relationship with Acc_Info_dirty.

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N (referential integrity)
rationale: Cross-table hint indicates S_N is a one-to-one key with Acc_Info_dirty.S_N. Every record in Cust_Bio_dirty must have a corresponding record in Acc_Info_dirty.

rule: Account_No must not be null (mandatory business identifier)
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business field linking to account information. Currently 0% missing but must be enforced.

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit code
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers (range 1001-1028). Values must maintain 4-character length to preserve leading zeros if converted to string.

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Name is a mandatory personal identifier field with 0% missing values currently.

rule: Name must not be in all lowercase or all uppercase (should be Title Case)
rationale: Evidence shows deterministic case deviations: 'lim wei jie' (all lower) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all upper) require standardization to Title Case.

check_params.logic: str(row['Name']).islower() or (str(row['Name']).isupper() and not any(p in str(row['Name']).upper() for p in ['S/O', 'D/O']))

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o for Male, Binte/d/o for Female)
rationale: Cultural naming conventions in Singapore/Malaysia use specific particles: 'Bin' and 's/o' indicate male; 'Binte' and 'd/o' indicate female. Mismatches suggest data quality issues.

check_params.logic: (re.search(r'\b(Binte|d/o)\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female') or (re.search(r'\b(Bin|s/o)\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male')

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID is a mandatory identifier with 0% missing values.

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter (e.g., S1234567D)
rationale: 93.3% of values follow this format. Anomalies detected: 'F212233V' (6 digits), '1916569C' (missing prefix). These 6.6% deviations must be flagged for review.

rule: ID_No must be unique (no duplicates)
rationale: National ID numbers should uniquely identify individuals. Evidence shows 29 distinct values with 1 duplicate ('F1011121T').

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Demographic field with 0% missing values.

rule: Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian (case-sensitive after standardization)
rationale: Evidence shows 3 underlying categories with case inconsistencies (MALAY, malay, indian). Must conform to canonical Title Case values.

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Demographic field with 0% missing values.

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female (case-sensitive after standardization)
rationale: Evidence shows 2 categories with case variations (male, FEMALE). Must conform to canonical Title Case values.

rule: Age must not be null
rationale: Mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values currently.

rule: Age must be numeric (parseable as integer)
rationale: Evidence shows 1 non-numeric value 'Twenty-five' (3.3%) in int64 column. Must be convertible to numeric.

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 (inclusive)
rationale: Domain constraint for human age. Current data shows -5 which is biologically impossible.

rule: Age must be at least 13 (realistic for service account)
rationale: Evidence specifically flags values below 13 as unrealistic for a service account context (observed: 4, -5).

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Evidence shows 6.7% missing values (2 records). While contact may be optional, existing nulls must be flagged for review.

rule: Contact_No must contain exactly 8 digits (Singapore phone number format)
rationale: Singapore phone numbers require 8 digits. Evidence shows inconsistent formatting (+65 prefix, spaces) and one 7-digit value '8964359'. All non-null values must normalize to 8 digits.

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Contact field with 0% missing values currently.

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol and no spaces
rationale: Evidence shows 4 structurally malformed emails (13.3%): 'not-an-email' (no @), 'useremail.com' (no @), 'nabilah@@example.com' (double @), 'zx91 @example.com' (contains space).

check_params.logic: '@' not in str(row['Email']) or ' ' in str(row['Email']) or str(row['Email']).count('@') != 1

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Geographic field with 0% missing values.

rule: Country must be standardized to 'Singapore' (no abbreviations, alternative languages, or casing variations)
rationale: Evidence shows 8 variations of Singapore (SG, S'pore, Singapura, 新加坡, SINGAPORE, etc.). Only canonical form 'Singapore' is valid after standardization.

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Address component with 0% missing values.

rule: Street_Name must not be in all uppercase (should be Title Case)
rationale: Evidence shows one all-caps value 'HOLLAND ROAD' deviating from dominant Title Case format.

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Address component with 0% missing values.

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Singapore postal codes are 6 digits. Evidence shows varying lengths (4 digits: '6907', 5 digits: '99999'). Must be converted to string and padded to 6 digits or flagged.

rule: Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for case differences)
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires name consistency across tables. Sample shows discrepancies: 'WANG SHI JIE' vs 'Wang Shi Jie', 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin' vs 'Danish'.

check_params.semantic_check: Name should match Full_Name exactly after normalizing case and whitespace

rule: ID_No must match ID in Acc_Info_dirty exactly for the same S_N
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires ID consistency. Sample shows mismatch: 'S8421753J' vs 'S8421753X'.
